home.faqSubtitle: Straight answers — no jargon, no fluff

faqs.question: What is an AI automation system?
faqs.answer: A set of AI agents and integrations that take over one recurring job in your business end to end — answering enquiries, following up leads, processing documents or reporting results. We connect it to the tools you already use (WhatsApp, calendar, CRM, email, accounting), train it on your services and run it for you. There is nothing for your team to install or learn.

faqs.question: Do I need all four systems?
faqs.answer: No. A common starting point is the capture system, so every WhatsApp enquiry gets a reply in under 3 seconds. Follow-up and reporting can be added afterwards. The four systems are built to work together, but each one works on its own — you add the next step when you're ready.

faqs.question: How fast is it live?
faqs.answer: The free AI audit takes 3 days and gives you the top automation opportunities for your business. The WhatsApp AI is live within 48 hours of onboarding: we connect your WhatsApp Business number, train the AI on your services and test it with your team. Larger builds across all four systems take 2–4 weeks.

faqs.question: Does it work for my clinic or small business?
faqs.answer: Yes, if your customers reach you on WhatsApp, email or web forms. Our focus is clinics — hair transplant, dental, cosmetic surgery and IVF, including medical tourism providers. The same systems also work for small service businesses that run on WhatsApp, such as real estate agencies. The AI can reply in 40+ languages, so international customers are covered too.

faqs.question: What does it cost?
faqs.answer: The WhatsApp AI has fixed pricing: €1,399 one-time setup plus €599 a month (Essential) or €999 a month (Pro), with a 3-month minimum. If it does not generate at least 3 qualified leads in your first 30 days, we refund your first month. Larger packages across the four systems — Starter, Growth and Scale — are quoted after a free audit, so you only pay for what will actually save you time.

faqs.question: Does it replace my staff?
faqs.answer: No — it replaces the repetitive work your staff do today: first replies at midnight, chasing leads that went quiet, copying data from documents into spreadsheets, building weekly reports. Your team still handles consultations, complex questions and decisions, and the AI hands over to a human whenever one is needed.
